about.title: Ibyerekeye
about.intro: {project} ni urubuga rwo gusangira amadosiye ya peer-to-peer rw'igisekuruza gitaha rwubatswe ku ikoranabuhanga rigezweho ridafite ikigo. Ihuza interface y'umukoresha yoroshye n'ubwubatsi bwuzuye budafite ikigo, igatanga umuti utekanye kandi wizewe wo gusangira amakuru utitayeho ubuyobozi bwo hagati. Umushinga ni open source kandi ukwirakwizwa hashingiwe ku {license}.

decentralized.title: Urusobe rwuzuye rudafite ikigo
decentralized.description: Nta serveri zo hagati, nta hantu hamwe ho gutsindwa. Abakoresha bashakisha kandi bakuramo ibikubiyemo bagwa ku giti cyabo, badashingiye ku bashinzwe ibikubiyemo, abagenzura cyangwa za database zo hagati.

accessControl.title: Igenzura ryihariye ryo kwinjira
accessControl.description: Buri wese afite ubwisanzure bwo gutangiza urusobe rwe rwite hamwe n'amategeko ye. Tanga uruhare rw'umukoresha muri buri rusobe: nyirubwite, abayobozi, abasohora, abagenzuzi n'abakuramo. Genzura neza uwo wese ushobora gusohora, kugenzura no gukuramo ibikubiyemo.

ui.title: Interface y'umukoresha y'icyiciro cyo hejuru
ui.description: Interface y'ikigo cy'ibitangazamakuru isobanutse kandi yoroshye yagenewe za desktop, TV n'amatelefoni. Genda nta nkomyi ukoresheje keyboard, imbeba, gamepad cyangwa kontorole ya kure. Abakoresha b'imbaraga bashobora gukoresha interface y'umurongo w'amabwiriza kugira ngo bakoreshe porogaramu nka serveri y'amadosiye idafite umutwe.

dataFormat.title: Imiterere y'amakuru isomwa n'umuntu
dataFormat.description: Imiterere y'amakuru ya LISH ishingiye kuri JSON, ibituma byoroshye gukora, gusoma no gusobanukirwa. Sangiza ibikubiyemo byawe na metadata isobanutse, igaragara umuntu uwo ari we wese ashobora gusuzuma byoroshye.

security.title: Ibanga n'umutekano
security.description: Itumanaho ryose rya peer-to-peer ryashizweho ibanga, kugira ngo amakuru yawe agume mu ibanga mu gihe yoherezwa. Abakoresha bashobora kwihisha inyuma ya VPN ku rwego rwiyongera rwo kutamenyekana. {project} yubahiriza ibanga ryawe muburyo bwo kuyikora.

crossPlatform.title: Cross-platform
crossPlatform.description: Porogaramu iraboneka kuri Windows, Linux na macOS. Ikoreshe kuri buri gikoresho ushaka.

download.title: Kuramo
download.description: Bona {project} kuri platform yawe. Bose bakuramo ku buntu kandi ni open source.
